label: D1 after a2 reached S2 (rewarded most), graded by S2-good belief
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action > 0) * ~((prev_action == 2) & (prev_state == 2)) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 2) * (prev_state == 2) * np.clip(-belief_lo, -3, 4) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == -1) * np.clip(-belief_lo, -3, 4) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == -1) * (in_rew == 1)
explanation: D1-only feature (zero at GO/D2); timing baseline (D1 level falling to ~0 in the last episode decile) gives R^2 0.28. Beyond timing, magnitude is set by the previous trial: near zero unless the last trial was a2 -> S2 (common); after a2 S2 rewarded it is highest, after a2 S2 unrewarded somewhat lower, and within a2 S2 trials it grows with the ideal-observer log-odds that S2 is good (-belief_lo). Every other previous pattern (a1 S1, a1 S2 rare, a2 S1 rare, rewarded or not) suppresses it to ~0, even when belief favours S2. On the window first trial (previous trial unknown in window) graded S2 belief and a reward input stand in. Trial-before history and ep-trial terms added little (<0.02). Observed-only: test R^2 beyond timing 0.637 (dev 0.649), vs all-observed reference 0.64 and all ceiling 0.72; the earlier model-policy explanation (policy decile alone 0.60) is matched, so little is lost by dropping model outputs.

issues: Reproduced: the original 6 terms score test R^2 beyond timing 0.637. The 'only at D1' claim holds (the GO/D2 baseline and residuals are exactly 0). The ordering a2 S2 r > a2 S2 u > all other previous patterns (about -0.7) holds in the residual table.

The claim 'adding late-episode terms gained less than 0.02' is false. Adding one term, (D1)*(prev a2 S2)*ep_dec, raises test R^2 from 0.637 to 0.702 (+0.065). Using a (ep_dec>=7) step instead gives 0.692. Adding ep_dec interactions for both the a2-S2 and first-trial terms gives 0.707, and a clip(ep_trial-50) shape gives 0.708.

Systematic error: the timing baseline is additive, but the feature fires almost only after a2->S2, so the late-episode fade has to scale that gated activation. With no such term, the model under-predicts early/mid-episode a2-S2 D1 steps (worst windows show actual about 3.3 vs predicted 0.8-2.0 at t5-t22) and over-predicts late ones.

A rescaled 8-term set, where the a2-S2 indicator, belief and reward terms (and the first-trial terms) are each multiplied by (1 - ep_dec/10), reaches test 0.726. That beats the claimed 'all' additive ceiling of 0.72 and the all-observed reference of 0.64, so the explanation is not near the ceiling as implied.

Minor: within a2 S2, the fitted r vs u indicator weights are nearly equal (+0.50 vs +0.46). The 'rewarded highest' difference in the raw residuals (+1.3 vs +0.32) is carried mostly by the S2 belief term, not by reward itself. The other belief-related terms checked add nothing: an S2-sign term gives 0.637, belief_cover gives 0.642, and the trial-before a2 term gives 0.637.
